sanitizedDescription: Undefined or garbage value returned to caller
reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: ae249b5fa27.c (Linux discontig memory). 'Undefined or garbage value returned to caller' at line 21 ('return (int)r'). 'r' is assigned from 'pfnnid_map[pfn]' at line 18 unconditionally before the return at line 21. 'r' cannot be garbage when line 21 is evaluated in the original code. Desugaring artifact: '#include <assert.h>' is inside '#ifdef CONFIG_DISCONTIGMEM' (line 4). The transformation desugars the assert macro expansion (with its NDEBUG and _ASSERT_H_DECLS guards) and the '__assert_fail' __noreturn call into conditional if-blocks. The Clang analyzer, seeing that '__assert_fail' is noreturn and that the assertion 'r != 0xff' always fails (pfnnid_map is all 0xff after setup_bootmem), may conclude that the only live path through the function calls __assert_fail and thus the function never properly reaches 'return (int)r' with an initialized 'r'. Related to TRANSFORMATION_64 for the same file — both are artifacts of the assert macro desugaring interacting with the '__noreturn' annotation.
